e.title: Aviareto / 开普敦公约国际登记处：全球航空器资产登记的运营方
e.title_en: Aviareto and the Cape Town Convention International Registry: the operator of global aircraft asset registration
e.title_hk: Aviareto／開普敦公約國際登記處：全球航空器資產登記的運營方
e.summary: 由 SITA 与爱尔兰政府合资、经 ICAO 选定依《开普敦公约》设立并运营「移动资产国际登记处」的机构：管理全球航空金融所依赖的登记系统已达 20 年，并公开治理、资源与新闻栏目
e.summary_en: A joint venture of SITA and the Irish Government, chosen by ICAO to establish and operate the International Registry of Mobile Assets under the Cape Town Treaty: it has run the registration system global aviation finance depends on for twenty years, and publishes governance, resource and news sections
e.summary_hk: 由 SITA 與愛爾蘭政府合資、經 ICAO 選定依《開普敦公約》設立並運營「移動資產國際登記處」的機構：管理全球航空金融所依賴的登記系統已達 20 年，並公開治理、資源與新聞欄目
e.body:
**Aviareto** 是**「移动资产国际登记处（International Registry of Mobile Assets）」的运营方**（站点标题实测 **「Aviareto - Managers of the International Registry of Mobile Assets」**）。本条目补的是**「航空器资产登记」这一形态**——**实测池内该形态为 0**；**它与同轮三条（[[iata]] 安全数据、[[ntsb]] 事故数据、[[flight-safety-foundation]] 风险标准）共同构成航空业务线，但补的是完全不同的一个环节：资产的权属与担保登记**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **首页 232.3KB，标题「Aviareto - Managers of the International Registry of Mobile Assets」**，正文逐字实测写明 **「At the centre of global aviation finance」**、**「For 20 years, Aviareto has managed the International Registry of Mobile Assets, the secure system that the multi-billion-dollar global aviation finance industry depends on every day」**；⭐⭐ **并逐字实测写明其身份与授权来源**：**「Aviareto is a joint venture between SITA and the Irish Government, chosen by ICAO to establish and operate the International Registry under the Cape Town Treaty」**；**以及来源构成**：**「Aviareto combines SITA’s global aviation expertise with the strengths of Ireland’s aviation sector」**；⭐ **「International Registry」页 `/international-registry/` 实测 226.9KB，标题「International Registry - Aviareto」**。**导航逐字实测的结构**：**International Registry**、**Governance**、**About us**、**Careers**、**Resources**、**News**、**Contact**；**链接实测另见** `/about/`、`/news/`、`/international-registry-a-force-for-change/`，以及**指向登记系统本身的地址** **`https://www.internationalregistry.aero/ir-web/`**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「航空器资产登记」这一环节，使本轮航空业务线形成完整闭环**——**同轮另三条分别给「安全数据」「事故调查」「风险标准」，本条给「资产权属与担保登记」**；**对做航空融资、租赁与航空保险核保的学生，登记是确定「这架飞机的抵押权/所有权状态」的基础设施**（**与池内金融基础设施类条目 [[susep-sro]] 的逐笔登记、[[mib]] 的车辆保险数据库同属「为特定资产建立的登记系统」，但对象与法律依据不同**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「SITA + 爱尔兰政府合资、经 ICAO 选定、依《开普敦公约》设立」这三点是可引用的制度事实**（**均为页面正文逐字实测**）——**它说明一个全球登记系统如何被授权与运营：国际公约提供法律基础、国际组织（ICAO）选定运营方、公私合资（航空业 IT 巨头 SITA + 一国政府）承担运营**；**对研究「国际公约如何落地为可运营基础设施」的学生，这是一个具体样本**（**注意：本次未打开任何一页说明其监管安排、收费或争议解决机制**）。**③ ⭐ 「20 年运营」与「数十亿美元级航空金融依赖」为页面自述**（**逐字实测**）；**对理解航空资产融资的规模与基础设施依赖关系有直接价值**（**但本次未核实其登记数量、交易规模或市场份额**）。**④ ⭐ 「爱尔兰」这一要素值得单独注意**——**爱尔兰是全球航空租赁业的核心辖区之一**，**而运营方是「爱尔兰政府 + SITA」的合资**；**这一点与池内 [[insurance-broker]]、[[marsh]] 等中介条目不同：本条给出的是「一个司法辖区如何通过承接国际登记职能而形成产业聚集」的线索**（**本次未打开任何一页论述爱尔兰航空业，故本词条不主张两者之间的因果关系**）。**⑤ 站点公开 Governance 与 Resources 栏目**（**本次未打开**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与「International Registry」页的存在、标题、页面体量、四处关键正文逐字表述（全球航空金融中心、20 年运营、SITA 与爱尔兰政府合资、经 ICAO 选定依开普敦公约设立）、导航结构、以及登记系统地址**，**但未打开 Governance、About us、Resources、News 等页面，未打开任何一页说明登记流程、费用、法律效力或争议解决，亦未访问登记系统本身**，因此**不能转述任何登记数量、交易规模、收费安排、法律条款或操作流程**；**② ⭐ 登记系统本身本次**未访问**——**实测到的 `https://www.internationalregistry.aero/ir-web/` 仅为页面中出现的地址**；**另经单独探活，`https://www.internationalregistry.aero/` 返回 HTTP 200（57.1KB，标题「International Registry - Home」），但其公开首页实测为一个「Guest User」电子签署与同意流程的界面（正文实测含「You are signing as Guest User in your role as Guest for Guest Entity. By clicking Confirm you are electronically signing and consenting…」）**——**即该登记处的公开落地页是访问与签署入口，而非信息性页面**；**故本词条不描述登记处的界面、字段或流程，也不为其单列条目**；**③ 「20 年」与「数十亿美元级」均为**页面自述**，**本次未独立核实**——**词条内已标注为页面自述**；**④ 「经 ICAO 选定」这一表述来自 Aviareto 自身页面**，**本次未在 ICAO 侧核实**（**而 ICAO 站点本轮实测 HTTP 403 阻断**），**故本词条按「Aviareto 自述」呈现，不主张已获第三方确认**；**⑤ 该机构与保险业的关系（如是否与航空保险核保/理赔有直接衔接）本次未核实，故不作关联主张**；**⑥ 首页标题与正文为英文，站点语言支持情况未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** Aviareto 提供精算工具、定价模型或可下载数据**。**核实说明**：`/international-registry/`（226.9KB）与首页（232.3KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与正文；**另单独探活 `www.internationalregistry.aero`（200，57.1KB，公开首页为 Guest User 电子签署/同意入口，故未描述其内容）**；**未打开 Governance、About us、Resources、News，未访问登记系统本身**。

e.body_en:
**Aviareto** is **the operator of the International Registry of Mobile Assets** (measured site title **"Aviareto - Managers of the International Registry of Mobile Assets"**). This entry adds the **"aircraft asset registration"** form — **measured zero**; **with [[iata]] (safety data), [[ntsb]] (accident data) and [[flight-safety-foundation]] (risk standards) in the same round it completes the aviation line, but covers an entirely different link: registration of ownership and security interests in assets**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **homepage is 232.3KB with the measured title "Aviareto - Managers of the International Registry of Mobile Assets"**, its body stating verbatim **"At the centre of global aviation finance"** and **"For 20 years, Aviareto has managed the International Registry of Mobile Assets, the secure system that the multi-billion-dollar global aviation finance industry depends on every day"**; ⭐⭐ and stating its identity and authorisation verbatim: **"Aviareto is a joint venture between SITA and the Irish Government, chosen by ICAO to establish and operate the International Registry under the Cape Town Treaty"**, with **"Aviareto combines SITA’s global aviation expertise with the strengths of Ireland’s aviation sector"**; ⭐ the **"International Registry" page measures 226.9KB**. **Structure read verbatim from navigation**: **International Registry**, **Governance**, **About us**, **Careers**, **Resources**, **News**, **Contact**; **measured links also include** `/about/`, `/news/`, `/international-registry-a-force-for-change/` and **an address pointing at the registry system itself**, **`https://www.internationalregistry.aero/ir-web/`**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the aircraft asset registration link, completing the round’s aviation line** — **the other three supply safety data, accident investigation and risk standards; this supplies registration of ownership and security interests**; **for students working on aviation finance, leasing and aviation underwriting, registration is the infrastructure that establishes an aircraft’s mortgage and ownership status** (**like [[susep-sro]]’s operation-level registry or [[mib]]’s vehicle insurance database, this is "a registry built for a specific asset class", but with a different object and legal basis**). **② ⭐⭐ "A SITA and Irish Government joint venture, chosen by ICAO, established under the Cape Town Treaty" is a citable institutional fact** (**all read verbatim from the page body**) — **it shows how a global registry is authorised and run: a treaty supplies the legal basis, an international organisation (ICAO) selects the operator, and a public-private venture (the aviation IT group SITA plus a national government) operates it**; **a concrete sample for studying how international conventions become operable infrastructure** (**note: no page on its regulatory arrangements, fees or dispute resolution was opened**). **③ ⭐ "20 years of operation" and "a multi-billion-dollar industry depends on it" are the page’s own statements** (**read verbatim**); **directly useful for understanding the scale of aviation asset finance and its infrastructure dependence** (**no registration count, transaction volume or market share was verified**). **④ ⭐ The Irish element deserves separate note** — **Ireland is one of the core jurisdictions of global aircraft leasing**, **and the operator is an Irish-Government and SITA joint venture**; **unlike intermediary entries such as [[insurance-broker]] and [[marsh]], this gives a lead on how a jurisdiction builds an industry cluster by hosting an international registry** (**no page discussing Irish aviation was opened, so no causal claim is made**). **⑤ Governance and Resources sections are public** (**not opened**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and the International Registry page’s existence, titles and sizes, four key verbatim body statements (centre of global aviation finance, 20 years, the SITA and Irish Government joint venture, ICAO selection under the Cape Town Treaty), the navigation structure and the registry system address**, **but opened no Governance, About us, Resources or News page, no page on registration process, fees, legal effect or dispute resolution, and did not access the registry system itself**, so **no registration count, transaction volume, fee arrangement, legal clause or operating process can be restated**; **② ⭐ The registry system itself was **not accessed** — **the measured `https://www.internationalregistry.aero/ir-web/` is only an address appearing on the page**; **separately probed, `https://www.internationalregistry.aero/` returned HTTP 200 (57.1KB, title "International Registry - Home"), but its public landing page measurably is a guest-user electronic signing and consent interface (body measured: "You are signing as Guest User in your role as Guest for Guest Entity. By clicking Confirm you are electronically signing and consenting…")** — **i.e. the registry’s public landing page is an access and signing entry point, not an informational page**; **so this entry describes no registry interface, field or process, and does not give it a separate entry**; **③ "20 years" and "multi-billion-dollar" are the page’s own statements**, **not independently verified** — **flagged as such in the entry**; **④ "chosen by ICAO" comes from Aviareto’s own page**, **and was not verified on the ICAO side** (**ICAO measured HTTP 403 and was blocked this round**), **so the entry presents it as Aviareto’s own statement and claims no third-party confirmation**; **⑤ its relationship with the insurance industry (for example any direct link to aviation underwriting or claims) was not verified, so none is asserted**; **⑥ the homepage title and body are English; language support was not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim Aviareto provides actuarial tools, pricing models or downloadable data**. **Verification note**: `/international-registry/` (226.9KB) and the homepage (232.3KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and body read verbatim; **`www.internationalregistry.aero` was separately probed (200, 57.1KB, public landing page a guest-user signing and consent interface, so its content is not described)**; **no Governance, About us, Resources or News page was opened and the registry system itself was not accessed**.

e.body_hk:
**Aviareto** 是**「移動資產國際登記處（International Registry of Mobile Assets）」的運營方**（站點標題實測 **「Aviareto - Managers of the International Registry of Mobile Assets」**）。本條目補的是**「航空器資產登記」這一形態**——**實測為 0**；**與同輪三條共同構成航空業務線，但補的是完全不同的環節：資產的權屬與擔保登記**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **首頁 232.3KB**，正文逐字實測 **「At the centre of global aviation finance」**、**「For 20 years, Aviareto has managed the International Registry of Mobile Assets…」**；⭐⭐ **並逐字實測其身份與授權來源**：**「Aviareto is a joint venture between SITA and the Irish Government, chosen by ICAO to establish and operate the International Registry under the Cape Town Treaty」**；⭐ **「International Registry」頁 `/international-registry/` 226.9KB**。**導航逐字實測**：**International Registry／Governance／About us／Careers／Resources／News／Contact**；**連結實測另見指向登記系統本身的地址 `https://www.internationalregistry.aero/ir-web/`**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「航空器資產登記」，使本輪航空業務線形成完整閉環**——**另三條給「安全數據」「事故調查」「風險標準」，本條給「資產權屬與擔保登記」**；**對做航空融資、租賃與航空保險核保的學生，登記是確定「這架飛機的抵押權／所有權狀態」的基礎設施**（與 [[susep-sro]] 的逐筆登記、[[mib]] 的車輛保險數據庫同屬「為特定資產建立的登記系統」）。**② ⭐⭐ 「SITA + 愛爾蘭政府合資、經 ICAO 選定、依《開普敦公約》設立」三點是可引用的制度事實**（**均為正文逐字實測**）——**它說明一個全球登記系統如何被授權與運營：國際公約提供法律基礎、國際組織選定運營方、公私合資承擔運營**。**③ ⭐ 「20 年運營」與「數十億美元級航空金融依賴」為頁面自述**（**逐字實測**）；**未核實其登記數量或市場份額**。**④ ⭐ 「愛爾蘭」這一要素值得單獨注意**——**愛爾蘭是全球航空租賃業的核心轄區之一**，**而運營方是「愛爾蘭政府 + SITA」合資**（**本次未打開任何一頁論述愛爾蘭航空業，故不主張因果關係**）。**⑤ 站點公開 Governance 與 Resources 欄目**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與「International Registry」頁的存在、標題、體量、四處關鍵正文逐字表述、導航結構、以及登記系統地址**，**但未打開 Governance／About us／Resources／News，未打開任何一頁說明登記流程、費用、法律效力或爭議解決，亦未訪問登記系統本身**，故**不能轉述任何登記數量、交易規模、收費安排、法律條款或操作流程**；**② ⭐ 登記系統本身本次**未訪問**——**實測到的 `/ir-web/` 僅為頁面中出現的地址**；⭐ **另經單獨探活，`https://www.internationalregistry.aero/` 返回 200（57.1KB，標題「International Registry - Home」），但其公開首頁實測為「Guest User」電子簽署與同意流程界面（正文實測含「You are signing as Guest User in your role as Guest for Guest Entity. By clicking Confirm you are electronically signing and consenting…」）**——**即該登記處的公開落地頁是訪問與簽署入口，而非資訊性頁面**；**故本詞條不描述其界面、欄位或流程，也不為其單列條目**；**③ 「20 年」與「數十億美元級」均為頁面自述，未獨立核實**；**④ 「經 ICAO 選定」來自 Aviareto 自身頁面**，**本次未在 ICAO 側核實**（**ICAO 站點本輪實測 403 阻斷**），**故按「Aviareto 自述」呈現，不主張已獲第三方確認**；**⑤ 與保險業的關係未核實，故不作關聯主張**；**⑥ 語言支持情況未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** Aviareto 提供精算工具、定價模型或可下載數據**。**核實說明**：兩個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與正文；**另單獨探活 `www.internationalregistry.aero`（200，57.1KB，公開首頁為 Guest User 電子簽署入口，故未描述其內容）**；**未打開 Governance／About us／Resources／News，未訪問登記系統本身**。
